payment_header.description: Optional. Omit on your first call to receive the x402 payment challenge for free. This server never holds a wallet and never pays on your behalf.

name.description: HTTP header name to attach, e.g. PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

value.description: HTTP header value (the signed payment payload).
